tools.name: clip.duplicate
tools.description: Duplicate the selected clips immediately after themselves.

tools.name: clip.nudge
tools.description: Nudge the selected clips along the timeline by a frame delta.

deltaFrames.description: Frames to move (negative = left, positive = right).

tools.name: clip.rippleDelete
tools.description: Ripple-delete the selected clips, closing the gaps they leave behind.

tools.name: clip.setSpeed
tools.description: Set the playback speed of the selected clips.

tools.name: clip.slip
tools.description: Slip the source in/out of the selected clips without moving them on the timeline.

delta.description: Frames to slip the source content (negative or positive).

tools.name: clip.split
tools.description: Split clips at the playhead (razor). Cuts all tracks or just the active one.

allTracks.description: Split every track when true, only the active track when false.

tools.name: edit.redo
tools.description: Redo the last undone edit.

tools.name: edit.selectAll
tools.description: Select every clip in the active sequence.

tools.name: edit.undo
tools.description: Undo the last edit.

tools.name: playback.goToEnd
tools.description: Move the playhead to the end of the sequence.

tools.name: playback.goToStart
tools.description: Move the playhead to the start of the sequence.

tools.name: playback.markIn
tools.description: Set the in point of the work area to the playhead.

tools.name: playback.markOut
tools.description: Set the out point of the work area to the playhead.

tools.name: playback.nextEdge
tools.description: Move the playhead to the next clip edge.

tools.name: playback.prevEdge
tools.description: Move the playhead to the previous clip edge.

tools.name: playback.step
tools.description: Step the playhead by a number of frames.

delta.description: Frames to step (negative = back, positive = forward).

tools.name: playback.togglePlay
tools.description: Toggle play/pause of the timeline.

tools.name: project.new
tools.description: Create a new empty project, replacing the current one.

tools.name: sequence.new
tools.description: Add a new sequence to the project and make it active.

tools.name: source.addColorMatte
tools.description: Add a color-matte clip on the top video track at the playhead.

color.description: Matte color as a hex string (e.g. "#1f2430").

tools.name: source.addMediaFile
tools.description: Import a media file (video/audio/image) from an absolute filesystem path and place it on the timeline at the playhead (video on V1 + linked audio on A1).

path.description: Absolute path to the media file to import.

tools.name: source.addTitle
tools.description: Add a title clip on the top video track at the playhead.

text.description: Title text shown on the clip.

tools.name: track.addAudio
tools.description: Add an audio track to the active sequence.

tools.name: track.addVideo
tools.description: Add a video track to the active sequence.
